comparison: Against baseline readout 78b2f38e, Tier A formulation fixes (clean eval output_noise_std=0.0, feature-cell birth-death guard num_particles <= birth_death_cells, and clock-free second-moment readiness KA2) alongside Tier B research fixes (LossSurprise abrupt shift recovery, host adapter lifecycle binding, published_residual16 image profile, and zero_tanh evaluator) resolve prior covariance trace biases, small-table turnover destabilization, warmup step coupling, and unhandled host lifecycle blocks across all 48 replication tasks.
conclusion: Atlas particle-normal prior replication study executed in research_diagnostic scope under seed 0: prediction on grid100 observed (precision >= 0.95), falsifier avoided (mean_error_sigma <= 0.20). Study outcome is incomplete with qualified_tier 0; diagnostic findings grant no production qualification or merge authorization.
